biography:
I currently serve as Senior Vice President of Sales at TERRANOVA, a hyperscale data center provider in Latin America. My role involves driving growth initiatives, fostering strategic partnerships, and delivering scalable solutions to address the data infrastructure needs of global hyperscalers, cloud providers and global enterprise clients.
Carrie has over 25+ year track record of over-achievement and success in building teams, driving revenue and long term partnerships. Strategically forging strong partner and customer relationships. Her focus has always been on global high profile customers.  Carrie has a proven track record of sales success in Technology, IT services, Global Networking, Managed Services, Data Center and Real Estate, and she has extensive experience in creating, negotiating and closing global complex deals and creating sales and revenue growth.  As Director of Sales at Vantage Data Centers, Carrie is keenly focused on driving global sales in the Hyper Scaler and Cloud provider space. Carrie focuses on long term strategic partnerships, business development and providing a white glove experience for her clients.
